en: Black‑and‑white image showing a rocky shoreline with many sailboats gathered close to land and others sailing out on the open water. People stand and sit on the rocks near small docking boats. The scene depicts a sailing regatta, with a calm sea and low islands or coastline in the background. Printed caption text appears in the lower left and a small publisher's logo with a number in the lower right.
